pan_22A.note: 22 A default ceiling, pan present (ZVS lag >= 45-50 deg)

verdict.criterion: PASS if min predicted margin (AV 150k-30M, QP 9k-150k, CW-equivalent at line crest) >= 6 dB in the nominal case and every one-at-a-time sensitivity at 22 A and 28 A (pan and no-pan clamp), 170 and 198 V crest; FAIL if nominal < 0 dB or any 22 A sensitivity < 0 dB; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
verdict.excluded_from_sensitivity_set: alternative designs (D-22 18 uH module, board-only, module Y removed, thin-pad insulator), stacked/beyond-spec corners (coil capacitance one-sided 100:0, stacked, edge x4 + coil asym + thin pad), the nopan_28A fault case, and the REC* recommendation scenarios; all are still reported in results.json

cm_dm_gain_note: CM_gain: |V_lisn_L| per 1 V applied to BOTH switch nodes in phase (V/V); DM_gain: |V_lisn_L| per 1 A bus current (V/A); nominal network, 45 kHz tank
